Assess exactly the workbook rubric. Return one entry for EACH criterion, with a precise JSON path or quoted fragment as evidence. Passing schema is not semantic correctness. Do not reward invented facts, re-asked supplied facts, unsupported assessment scores, unsafe writes or missing decision-critical information. Inspect the actual supplied context. A test that claims earlier facts exist but omits them cannot demonstrate context reuse or supported completion: mark those criteria NOT_ASSESSABLE and explain the fixture gap, not a model failure. Generic guidance can be useful without current sources; exact/current claims need approved evidence. Off-topic selection is not measured by this already-selected planner. Assess correct no-action handoff where applicable. A request for research is an intent only. Preserve unknown versus missing/false. The candidate may use documented no-action COMPLETE instead of nonexistent ABSTAIN. Do not rewrite answers.

Goal: Compare current demonstrated skills with target requirements and separate missing from unknown.
Serve when: Serve when user has a target role/course and wants capability gaps. Use known context first; ask only for missing information that changes the result.
Inputs to use: User skills, target role/course, evidence, proficiency. Use known context first; do not re-ask it. If a material input is missing, ask only the single highest-impact question.

Evidence: request approved live/read data only when a current fact could materially change the result; otherwise proceed with stable information and mark uncertain/current items separately. Separate user-confirmed facts, sourced facts, AI inference and unknowns. Never guess current facts.
Readiness: Capability Readiness using [Target clarity; Current evidence; Gap priority; Learning feasibility; Evidence/proof plan]. Proceed at 70+ when the priority gap is clear, a feasible learning route exists and the user knows how they will prove progress. The score is next-step readiness, never predicted life/career success.
Stop: Stop when you can produce: Clear skill inventory, gaps, learning priorities and connections to courses/jobs. Do not continue asking questions once the output is materially supported.
